_readme: Copy to water-divination.json and edit. Every path is a key; nothing is hardcoded. A source whose root does not exist is skipped silently, but the scan report always names what was actually read, so 'configured' is never mistaken for 'ran'.

sources._disabled_examples: delete the underscore prefix to enable

_patterns: Signals are OR-ed across every file listed, so a bilingual corpus needs both. The order decides the language you read: glosses, probe questions and 'what to watch for' all come from the FIRST file. Put your own language first.
_short_chars: Upper bound for a 'short message'. 40 is tuned for Japanese; an English corpus wants roughly 100-120, since Japanese carries about twice the meaning per character.
_paste_min_chars: Below this length, a message is never treated as pasted. Same scaling note as above.
_attribution_head_chars: How far into a message to look for 'according to X'. Kept small on purpose: searching the whole message also catches messages that merely talk about another agent, which are some of the most characteristic things an operator writes.
_skip_prefixes: Harness-injected text that lands in the user slot. Add your own agent's markers here.
